candidates.pitch: Souls-like gladiator duel where wounds stay: each heavy hit taken slows that limb for the round.
Gladiator duel where every deathblow swaps you into the loser's body, and your abandoned body fights on.
Colosseum duel where each new round, your last round's recorded self joins the rival against you.
Colosseum duel under a sundial: shade restores posture, sunlight drains it, and the shadow sweeps the sand.
Night games: torches ring the sand; every parry snuffs one, and the duel ends in darkness.

concept.why: Left the standard's families (wall breaches, crowd weapons, chains, disarms, champion ladder) for who-you-control. A swap changes your archetype every kill, and your abandoned body hunts you. The obvious wounds idea only tunes damage.
concept.hook: every deathblow swaps you into the body you just beat

references.borrow: posture bar fills on blocked and parried hits; a full bar opens a one-press deathblow
parry a heavy and a light is guaranteed; parry a light and a heavy is
possess any enemy body and play with its moves, health and weaknesses

pillars.rules_out: Hits that only shove, blocks with no attacker recoil, parries without a stunned attacker

pillars.line: Skill is in the feet and the timing
pillars.rules_out: Auto-face, lock-on aim, wide arcs over 60 degrees, speed stats
Snowballing leads; the scorer always inherits the wounded body

verbs.input: J: light swing, clip strike; chain windup 12; hit 9 HP, +2; blocked: -2, safe
verbs.cancel: Roll in the last 4 recovery frames; 8-frame buffer; whiff plays the full 16 frames

verbs.input: K: heavy, clip strike_heavy; hyper armour f12-37; hold to f54 for a charged unblockable
verbs.cancel: Feint before f20 for 6 stamina; blocked: attacker recoils, -22, light guaranteed

verbs.input: I: shoulder or shield bash, clip body_check; unblockable, GUARDBROKEN 30; wall behind: WALLSPLAT 60
verbs.cancel: Loses to any active hit and to a roll; whiffed bash is -24

verbs.input: L tap: parry, clip block; parried light +44, heavy +28; hold L: block 4/held/6
verbs.cancel: Whiffed parry costs 8 stamina and 20 frames; re-tap within 30 f shrinks the window by 4

verbs.input: Space plus a direction: roll, clip roll; i-frames 4-21; costs 20 stamina
verbs.cancel: Hits in roll recovery are counter-hits; exhausted adds 12 recovery frames

playstyles.title: The Dancer

loops.s30: Fill the rival's posture with parries and splats, land a deathblow, wake in the beaten body

skill.floor: Press light at a rival who only walks in and swings slowly; it hits and he flinches
ceiling: Parry a heavy and take the guaranteed light, then chain into a heavy
Bash a rival against the wall for a splat, then charge a heavy into it
Feint a heavy to bait the parry, then bash the parry window

feel.knockback: Impulse = base by move (light 0.25 m, heavy 0.6 m, bash 1.0 m) plus 0.01 m per HP lost, via TLBiped.shove over body mass
feel.reaction: TLHit.react from the blow's side: flinch 0.3, stagger 0.7; attacker recoils on block, staggers when parried; TLHit.down only for charged, exhausted bash, deathblow
feel.whiff: Full recovery, a swish via TLAudio.play, no burst, the swinging arm overextends and the body leans forward
feel.shake: None on light; 0.08 m over 10 f on heavy hits; 0.2 m on wall splat; 0.3 m over 24 f on a soul swap
feel.camera: Raised orbit, pitch 40 deg, framing a pivot between both fighters at 0.26 frame height; low parapet only on the camera side

clips.moment: The deathblow lands, white flash, and the player stands up in the giant shield body
The player bashes their own former body into the wall for a splat
A charged heavy is parried, sword flies wide, the guaranteed light lands

design.first_minute: The sand opens on Old Varro walking in slowly with a shoulder dip; one HUD line: J strike, L parry, break his guard

out_of_scope: Story cutscenes and menus before the first fight

design_reviewed.notes: Ship it. Before the build: give the player's soul a persistent marker (gold plume glow and ground ring) that moves to the new body on the swap, so nobody loses track of who they are. Say how long an HP-0 deathblow window lasts (use BROKEN 90 f). Clamp the right-drag orbit to the parapet side, or set the stands back so the lens never enters them. No slop found.

brief.pitch: Duel gladiators in a colosseum; break their guard, deathblow them, and wake up inside their beaten body.

aspects.title: Deathblow Swaps Bodies
aspects.line: Finish them and you wake up inside their body
aspects.detail: A heavy on a BROKEN body is a deathblow: both freeze 20 f, then souls swap. You play the beaten body (HP kept, at least 25); the rival soul drives your old body with its own habits. Both postures reset to 0, 45 f of i-frames. First soul to 3 deathblows wins.

alternatives.title: Plain Finisher
alternatives.line: A deathblow just ends the round, like any duel

alternatives.title: Ghost Body
alternatives.line: Your old body keeps fighting beside the rival, two against one

aspects.title: Three Gladiator Bodies
aspects.line: Big shield, quick sword or twin blades: each defends differently
aspects.detail: Wall: poise 40, HP 120, blocks at x0.7 stamina. Duelist: poise 20, HP 100, parry window 14. Dancer: poise 10, HP 85, roll i-frames 3-18. Same move frames from the duel table; each body is its own TLKit build and size, body_scale on the capsule.

alternatives.title: Weapon Loadouts
alternatives.line: One gladiator, swap weapons between rounds instead of bodies

alternatives.title: Beast Bodies
alternatives.line: Swap into a lion or a bull as well

aspects.title: Souls With Habits
aspects.line: Each rival keeps their tricks, whatever body they steal
aspects.detail: A rival is a soul: name, voice, one habit with a 24 f tell, kept across swaps. Varro taunts after two blocked hits; Sabina taps her blade before a riposte; Ixi spins after a flurry. Ladder AI tiers: react 30/22/18/15 f, defend_p 0.30-0.70, read_p 0.10-0.65, return window 36-18 f.

alternatives.title: Body Rivals
alternatives.line: Rivals are just their bodies; a swap gives you their tricks

alternatives.title: Endless Gauntlet
alternatives.line: Fresh rival after every deathblow, survive as long as you can

aspects.line: Slam them into the stone wall for a big stagger
aspects.detail: Sand circle 24 m across ringed by a 1.2 m stones wall. Bash with a wall within 1.2 m behind = WALLSPLAT 60; knocked into the wall in hitstun = WALLSPLAT 40. Gates (entrance kit) open at 40 s and the wall ring shrinks to 18 m.

alternatives.title: Open Sand

aspects.title: Crowd That Turns
aspects.line: The crowd cheers parries and boos the runner
aspects.detail: Crowd meter fed by parries, splats, punished taunts and deathblows; drained by retreating over 2 s. At full meter the crowd throws a palm: +20 stamina and posture regen x2 for 5 s, visible as a TLVfx confetti burst and cheer.

brief.rules: Best of 3 rounds of 75 s. A round is won by the first soul to land 3 deathblows; a deathblow opens when a body's posture fills (BROKEN 90 f) or its HP hits 0, and is a heavy on that body. Every deathblow swaps souls: you inherit the beaten body (HP kept, minimum 25) and the rival takes your fresher one, so the leader always fights wounded: the visible comeback rule. Clock out: more deathblows, then higher body HP. Verbs copy the duel table: light 18/4/16, heavy 32/5/28 (hold to 54 charged, unblockable), bash 14/6/24, parry tap 1/12/20, block hold 4/held/6, roll 3/18/15. Resources HP 100, stamina 100, posture 100 per the playbook 6.1. Every contact changes both bodies with hit-stop on both: hit 5/9 f, block 3/6 f (blocked heavy recoils the attacker, -22, light guaranteed), parry 10 f (attacker PARRIED 52 light / 36 heavy, weapon knocked away), clash 8 f both REBOUND 20, bash GUARDBROKEN 30, wall splat 12 f. Whiffs play full recovery with a swish, no burst. Hits react by poise tier with TLHit.react; only charged hits, exhausted bashes and deathblows use TLHit.down. Intensity: calm 10 s open, pressure waves as stamina runs out and resets, gates open at 40 s and the ring shrinks, last 15 s a war horn and sudden-death if tied. End screen names the cause (PARRIED HEAVY, WALLSPLAT, DEATHBLOW 3) and one key restarts in under 2 s.
brief.arena: A 24 m sand circle, flat ground_patch, ringed by a 1.2 m stones wall that splats; behind it raked stands on three sides, entrance gates at north and south, flags and two light masts. At 40 s the gates open and stones slide in to an 18 m ring, forcing close range. The camera is a raised orbit, pitch 40 degrees, framing a pivot between the fighters at 0.26 of frame height; the camera side has only the low parapet and no pillars, so the lens never sits behind scenery. Scoreboard behind the far wall shows deathblows per soul.
brief.ai: Seeded state machine SPACING, PRESS, DEFEND, PUNISH, RESET, perceiving only visible states after react_frames; remembers the last 8 player responses and never repeats a string 3 times. Rung 1 Old Varro, a soul who starts in the Wall body (big, broad, tower shield, bronze helm): taunts after 2 blocked hits, shield bash with a shoulder dip tell 24 f before contact; roars when he scores, sags and slaps the sand when beaten. Rung 2 Sabina Quickhand in the Duelist body (lean, gladius, crested helm): parries the 3rd hit of a string, taps her blade 24 f before a riposte; bows on scoring, curses when parried. Rung 3 Little Ixi in the Dancer body (small, twin blades, no helm): 4-hit flurry then a delayed spin heavy held 30 f; giggles and taunts after a flurry, spins in place when beaten. Champion, the Red Lion, uses all three habits and the champion tier. After a swap each soul keeps its habit but plays the new body's defence. Harder rungs mean shorter return windows (36, 28, 22, 18 f), higher defend_p and read_p, never speed or damage.
brief.controls: Move: WASD camera-relative, the body turns to its walk direction, no auto-face. Light: J or left mouse. Heavy: K or right mouse, hold for charged. Guard: L, tap to parry, hold to block. Roll: Space plus a direction. Bash: I. Camera: right-drag orbits. Light restarts on the end screen.
brief.mood: Sun-bleached sand, inked toon stone and red cloth under the house style; brass horns, a roaring crowd that hushes on a broken guard, a deep gong and a white flash on every soul swap.
